# Shipped egress allowlist for the Google Antigravity CLI (provider API
# endpoints only — ADR-001 Decision 7;
# docs/adr/001-task-delegation-privilege-model.md).
#
# Do NOT edit this file to add domains: extensions live in user-owned config
# at ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/second-opinion/allowlist.d/antigravity.txt
# (or $SECOND_OPINION_ALLOWLIST_DIR/antigravity.txt) and are surfaced loudly
# at invocation time. Broad entries (github.com, shared CDNs) reopen
# exfiltration paths — keep extensions tight.
#
# One domain per line; `#` starts a comment; `*.example.com` wildcards are
# supported by srt.
#
# Verified against agy 1.1.4 under srt: with exactly these domains a print-
# mode run succeeds; the CLI's non-essential fetches (avatar images from
# lh3.googleusercontent.com, playwright browser downloads from
# *.azureedge.net) stay blocked and are harmless.

# OAuth token refresh + token info.
oauth2.googleapis.com
www.googleapis.com

# Model/code-assist API (release channels use prefixed variants of
# cloudcode-pa: stable uses the bare domain, daily builds daily-...).
cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com
daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com

# Experiments/feature-flag service polled at startup.
antigravity-unleash.goog

# Play services config endpoint contacted during startup.
play.googleapis.com
